'''Yufwa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the interests of his homeworld, [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he proposed an amendment to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] which was planned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].
